description: Ministry of Justice and Labour Relations - Collective Agreement for non-executive grades 2013-2016 entered into between Sri Lanka Insurance Corporation Limited and Members of Insurance Employees' Union and Sri Lanka Nidahas Sevaka Sangamaya
reasoning: This gazette content publishes a collective agreement between Sri Lanka Insurance Corporation Limited and trade unions under the Industrial Disputes Act. It contains detailed regulatory provisions about employment terms, conditions, and dispute resolution procedures. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves the publication of a legally binding agreement that establishes regulatory frameworks for employment practices, which is a form of subsidiary legislation under the Industrial Disputes Act.
